title: Separate semantic task failure from invalid tool protocol
narrative: Taloneth needs cross-harness evaluation to classify invalid tool names and schema errors separately from simply getting the task wrong. Accepts FineEnvs out-of-harness failure modes[^fineenvs-xharness].
implementation: `CrossHarnessFailure` and `classify_cross_harness_failure` in `mechaharness.cross_harness_failure` emit taxonomy kinds usable as claims inside matrix cells.
validation: Kind `cross_harness_failure_classify`. Soft expects invalid_tool_name. Unit tests in `tests/test_cross_harness_failure.py`.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — leaving native harness
